'''Weir's base'''<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|252|Leyli, Lady}}</ref> was an underground [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base located on [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]] and used by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Weir/Legends|Weir]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].

The base was abandoned following the [[Mission to Tralus|attack]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].
